'''Zorbazat Xong''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yevetha]] [[Minister of Homeworld Security]] on [[N'zoth]]. Xong learned [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] to communicate with outsiders, which he viewed as shameful but necessary. Although he despised all non-Yevetha, Xong tolerated outsiders' business for the economic benefits.

At some point during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], before the [[Destruction of N'zoth|Battle of N'zoth]], Xong allowed a group of [[New Republic Intelligence]] operatives to oversee the interrogation of a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], during which Xong brutally beat and attempted to murder the captive.
